a.xlink:title: Main roll controller: EKF plus gain-scheduled control law, in its own loop.

Computes the canard deflection. Call after the EKF step.
Atmosphere and wind at alt_m, interpolated from the built-in weather profile.
Fills the derived fields. Call once after setting everything else.
Loads the Control Freak flight parameters into cfg.
Milliseconds since boot (HAL_GetTick()).
Vertical (world z) velocity in m/s from the EKF state: the body velocity rotated into the world frame...
Prediction only. Call when no new IMU sample is available.
Clears the rate limiter and the effectiveness monitor (sign back to +1).
Resets the state to cfg.x0 and the covariances to their initial values.
Appends msg and a newline, then flushes to the card.

One prediction and correction. Call when a fresh IMU sample is available.

Gain K = I3 · λ / (∂M/∂ζ) for the current airspeed.
∂M/∂ζ (N·m per rad) at airspeed v_mag. ControlLaw divides by this to set its gain.
Roll inertia (kg·m²) at time t: linear from I_3_0 to I_3_f during the burn.
Copies n floats from src to dst.
World-to-body rotation matrix (DCM) from a unit quaternion.
Renormalizes the quaternion part of xhat, or resets it to identity if its norm is near zero.
Euler-integrates xhat over dt and propagates P with F = I + A·dt.
Full nonlinear equations of motion, ẋ = f(t, x, u).
N×N identity matrix.
Numerical Jacobian ∂f/∂x by central differences (step 1e-5, 20 eom() calls).
Canard roll moment (N·m) for airspeed v_mag and deflection zeta_rad: coeff · v² · ζ(deg).
Writes both PWM compare registers for input plus the configured offsets (deg).
Converts readRawVoltage() to degrees relative to _zeroVoltage (360° per 3.3 V).
Reads both feedback voltages from ADC3 and smooths them.
